title: Subcubic graphs without eigenvalues in $(-1, 1)$
summary: Guo and Royle recently classified the connected cubic graphs without eigenvalues of their adjacency matrix in the open interval $(-1, 1)$, and raised the question of extending their classification to graphs of maximum degree at most $3$. Together with their cubic classification, our result fully answers this question by characterizing all connected subcubic graphs that are not cubic and have no eigenvalues in $(-1,1)$. We show that exactly two infinite families and seven sporadic examples occur, and that every sporadic graph has at most $18$ vertices. To obtain this complete classification,…
